title: Nissan UD MK Condor hi-tensile Aluminium Bullbar #6
description: UD MK11.250 Condor hi-tensile aluminium Bullbar. heavy duty contoured channel to suit driving, plus fog lights. Main cross tubes is one piece 63mm tube through drilled uprights and recessed into the outer uprights. Tow pin and heavy duty steel backing plate. Driving light mounts can be fitted to customer requirements. Optional poly-carbonate headlight covers.
